cells.gaps: No figure for the whole population for 2023 or later has been found; the 2024 census figure covers literate people aged 10 and over only.
cells.note: The latest figure held, 15.7 per cent for 2019, is before 2023, so no rung is set. INS's 2024 census figure (77.4 per cent of women, 75.8 of men) covers literate people aged 10 and over only, a group, and is not staged.
